description: This file contains a test suite for the GatewaySession component, testing WebSocket connection logic, token handling, and invoke request round-tripping in an Android environment using Kotlin, Robolectric, and MockWebServer.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: A simple in-memory implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore for testing.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class encapsulating a GatewaySession, its Job, and associated device auth store for testing.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: Holds the request and JSON result of a runInvokeScenario test.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: A test suite class running various connection and invoke request tests for GatewaySession.

methods.name: connect_usesBootstrapTokenWhenSharedAndDeviceTokensAreAbsent
methods.description: Tests that bootstrap token is used when shared and device tokens are missing.

methods.name: connect_prefersStoredDeviceTokenOverBootstrapToken
methods.description: Tests that stored device token is preferred over bootstrap token during connection.

methods.name: connect_retriesWithStoredDeviceTokenAfterSharedTokenMismatch
methods.description: Tests retry logic with stored device token after token mismatch error.

methods.name: connect_storesPrimaryDeviceTokenFromSuccessfulSharedTokenConnect
methods.description: Verifies that primary device token is stored from a successful shared token connection.

methods.name: bootstrapConnect_storesAdditionalBoundedDeviceTokensOnTrustedTransport
methods.description: Tests storing of additional bootstrap device tokens during bootstrap connection.

methods.name: nonBootstrapConnect_ignoresAdditionalBootstrapDeviceTokens
methods.description: Ensures non-bootstrap connects ignore bootstrap device tokens.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_roundTripsInvokeResult
methods.description: Verifies that invoke requests correctly round-trip and produce expected results.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_usesParamsJsonWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks method behavior when Params JSON is provided.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_mapsCodePrefixedErrorsIntoInvokeResult
methods.description: Ensures code-prefixed errors are mapped into invoke results properly.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability_sendsObjectParamsAndUpdatesScopedUrl
methods.description: Tests the refresh of node canvas capability, including URL updates.

methods.name: testJson
methods.description: Utility returning a preconfigured Json instance.

methods.name: createNodeHarness
methods.description: Helper to create a test harness with a GatewaySession and auth store.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Helper for connecting a GatewaySession to a test server endpoint.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Helper to await connection establishment or throw on timeout.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Helper to properly shut down test harness and server.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Runs a test scenario with a specific invoke event frame and checks results.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket response frame with optional canvas URL and auth JSON.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Creates and starts a mock WebSocket server with specified request handling.
